fullPassage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy that is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) renewable(재생 가능한), (B) industrial(산업적인), (C) scarce(부족한, 희귀한)
det.analysis:
✅ ② renewable — industrial — scarce: 원문 일치
❌ ① disposable은 '일회용'이라는 뜻으로 재생에너지와 반대
❌ ③ recreational은 '오락의'로 문맥 불일치
❌ ④ abundant는 scarce의 반의어
det.tip: renewable ↔ disposable, scarce ↔ abundant

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) concrete(콘크리트의), (B) excavated(채굴된), (C) expensive(비싼)

❌ ① deposited는 '퇴적된'으로 excavated의 반의어
❌ ④ affordable은 expensive의 반의어
det.tip: excavate(채굴하다) ↔ deposit(퇴적시키다), expensive ↔ affordable

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: reinforcing — frequently — diversify

det.tip: undermine(약화시키다) ↔ reinforce(강화하다), seldom(거의 ~않는) ↔ frequently(자주), focus(집중하다) ↔ diversify(다양화하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② common(흔한)은 원문 scarce(희귀한)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 변환은 화석 연료 없이는 일어날 수 없다
det.analysis:
✅ ① fossil fuels: 재생에너지 인프라 구축에 화석 연료가 필수적이라는 역설적 주장 ←정답
❌ ② foreign investment: 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ public support: 대중 지지는 언급되지 않음
❌ ④ advanced technology: 기술이 아닌 화석 연료가 핵심
det.tip: 재생에너지 역설: 재생에너지 인프라를 만들려면 화석 연료가 필요

questions.passage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy that is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster ____ This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재생에너지 시스템을 향해 밀어붙일수록, 건설 과정에서 화석 에너지 사용이 더 빨라진다
det.analysis:
❌ ① global warming will be solved: 해결된다는 글의 논지와 반대
✅ ② we have to use fossil energy for the construction process: 재생에너지 건설에 화석 연료가 필수라는 역설 ←정답
❌ ③ mineral costs will decrease significantly: 비용 감소는 언급되지 않음
❌ ④ emissions will be eliminated completely: 배출 제거는 오히려 어렵다는 문맥
det.tip: the harder ~ the faster: ~할수록 더 빨리 ~한다 (비교급 상관구문)

ch: we have to use fossil energy for the construction process
